我曾经是个爱玩的孩子。儿时和小伙伴围在一起玩经典地产类桌游：大家去买地、收租金，: I was once a kid who loved to play. As a child I would gather with friends around a classic property-trading board game: everyone bought land, collected rent, and at the end the player with the most assets won. It was simple and lively.
二十年后的某个夜晚，我忽然有了这样的灵感：参考一部分经典地产类桌游的规则，再做一: One night twenty years later, an idea came to me: borrow some of those classic property-trading rules, extend them, and share what I know about Amazon Web Services and cloud architecture through a game, so people can pick up cloud architecture easily while they play, and make it a game of our own, for our community. That is how Cloud Tycoon came about.
希望 User Group 能帮助更多的小伙伴快速上手亚马逊云科技，也希望你在这: I hope the User Group helps many more people get started with Amazon Web Services quickly, and I hope that here you can find again the joy of gathering around the dice with friends as a kid.
要付费或者注册吗？: Do I need to pay or sign up?
不用。云上大亨完全免费，打开网页就能玩，不需要注册账号，也不用安装任何东西。游戏: No. Cloud Tycoon is completely free and runs in your browser: no account, nothing to install. The source code is public on GitHub.
2–4 人。可以在同一台电脑上轮流操作，也可以各用各的电脑或手机联机，画面实时同: 2–4 players. Take turns on the same computer, or play online from your own computers or phones with the screen synced in real time, and invite friends to spectate. Short on players? Add computer players.
不懂云计算也能玩吗？: Can I play without knowing cloud computing?
能。入门局只保留买服务、收过路费、运行费和维护窗口这些基础规则；每块服务、每个架: Yes. Beginner keeps only the basic rules: buying services, collecting rent, running costs, and the Maintenance Window. Every service and architecture has an explainer page, so you learn as you play.
一局要玩多久？: How long does a game take?
默认打满 15 轮按估值排名，大约 20 分钟；娱乐模式默认 10 轮，更快。也: By default you play 15 rounds and rank by valuation, which takes about 20 minutes; Party Mode defaults to 10 rounds and is even quicker. You can also set a time limit, or drop the round limit and play until someone wins.
国内访问慢怎么办？: The game loads slowly. What can I do?
国内用户请走国内线路 aws-game.usergroup.cn；海外用户可以用: Outside mainland China, use the international site on GitHub Pages; in mainland China, use aws-game.usergroup.cn. Both have the same content.
能在线下活动里用，或者打印成实体桌游吗？: Can I use it at in-person events, or print it as a physical board game?
可以。开局页有「UG 活动局」一键开局；仓库里还有主持人规则书、UG 活动流程单: Yes. The start screen has a one-click “UG Meetup Game” setup, and the repository has a host rulebook, a UG event run sheet, a quick reference card, plus printable cards, board, and components (all in Chinese).
不是。游戏内价格为虚构，不代表实际定价，$ 是游戏币单位。: No. Prices in the game are fictional and do not reflect actual pricing; $ is the in-game currency unit.

输赢之外，还有一座云架构学习中心: Win or lose, there's a whole cloud architecture learning center
游戏里每块服务、每个有效架构都能点进讲解页，中文、English、日本語三种语言: Every service and every architecture in the game opens a guide page, in Chinese, English and Japanese, with subtitles and voice-over.
三分钟，看一场云上大冒险: A three-minute adventure in the cloud
序章「韩叔的出师考」拉开大幕，四位 UG 伙伴买服务、搭架构、争夺冠军奖杯，片尾: The prologue, "Uncle Han's Final Exam", kicks things off as four UG friends buy services, build architectures and race for the trophy, with an Easter egg waiting at the end.
云上大亨宣传片封面：四位卡通角色在云服务棋盘上争夺 User Group 冠军奖: Cloud Tycoon trailer cover: four cartoon characters on a cloud-service board competing for the User Group trophy
每个一两分钟，挑一个最对胃口的: One to two minutes each. Start with the one that suits you.
带去你的 User Group 活动: Bring it to your User Group
线上联机、线下开黑都合适。开局页有专门给活动准备的「UG 活动局」，仓库里还有整: Great for online play and in-person game nights. The start screen has a dedicated "UG Meetup Game" preset, and the repository has a full set of event handbooks and print-and-play files.
开局页一键开局: One click from the start screen
12 轮或 30 分钟，先到为准: 12 rounds or 30 minutes, whichever comes first
每一轮都写进了更新说明：改了什么、为什么改，还附上模拟对局的数据。: Every round is written up in the release notes: what changed, why, and data from simulated games.
准备好成为云上大亨了吗？: Ready to become a Cloud Tycoon?
打开浏览器，叫上一两位朋友，20 分钟后见分晓。: Open your browser, grab a friend or two, and find out who wins in 20 minutes.
亚马逊云科技 User Group 原创的云架构桌游。买服务、组架构、控账单，和: An original cloud architecture board game by the Amazon Web Services User Group. Buy services, build architectures, keep your bill in check and race your friends for the trophy, getting to know what cloud services can do one roll at a time.
